name: reborn-plan-m13-classes-1800
description: borg-zoo#123 development study: borg-reborn-rs's class errands plan crossed with the M13 shopping (live town planner + trip policy), 2x2, plus a fifth arm with the ambitious plan and shopping, all on one specimen (4.2.6-reborn-rust-plans-m13, borg-reborn-rs 1c4b351b, the same game as the pilot's 2f74e1c5, adding only the ambitious plan), on classes-1800 (9 classes x 200 seeds, assigned birth, 100,000-turn cap). 9,000 games.
prespecified: Fixed 2026-11-16, before any result was read; follows rs-kit-trip-development. Descriptive development study. Primary endpoint: fewer natural deaths first. Then mean final character level, mean deepest level and the DL5+ count, including dead characters. Every result is reported per class, because the plan differs by class. Paired rescued and newly killed counts against reborn-m13-control for each arm. Factorial effects: plan, shopping and plan x shopping. Incomplete, config_error and borg_stopped cells are reported separately. Nothing here confirms a winner; that needs a fresh confirmation suite. Amended 2026-11-16, before any result of this experiment was read (only the classes-18 plumbing pilot had run): a fifth arm, reborn-m13-ambitious-shop, is added and compared with reborn-m13-control and with reborn-m13-plan-shop (paired rescued and newly killed counts, per class); it is outside the 2x2 factorial. The study runs on 4.2.6-reborn-rust-plans-m13, which sits beside the four-arm pilot's 4.2.6-reborn-rust-plan-m13 (the same game; it only adds the ambitious plan). Neither carries the #355 survival fix. The plan in force is evidenced by the core's copy of the loaded plan in the cell's output directory (errands_plan.txt), whose sha256 must equal the requested plan's, and which must be absent in no-plan arms; otherwise the cell is config_error. A cell with 1,000 or more keys at a single game turn (borg-rs#90's oil store/take loop at the Home: 4,315-5,141 keys per burst against at most 383 in normal play) is recorded as stalled, with its observed outcome kept, and is reported separately like the other incomplete outcomes; final key counts are also reported per arm.
owner_authorization: 2026-11-15: the owner authorised the borg-reborn-rs errands plan x M13 shopping experiment (borg-zoo#123); proposed scale 7,200 games on classes-1800 after the classes-18 pilot. Dispatch remains the owner's call. 2026-11-16: the owner added the ambitious-plan arm (issue addendum) and chose the pre-#355 game (borg-reborn-rs#379).
